name: ramback
description: See and stop the dev stack on a Mac: simulators, emulators, Gradle, Docker and dev servers, with their RAM.

tools.name: list_running
tools.description: Simulators, emulators, daemons, containers, dev servers and databases running now, with RAM and whether the agent may stop them.

tools.name: stop
tools.description: Stops a row by id or port, or a project's rows. Never pinned rows, databases, builds, or what another agent started.

tools.name: free_memory
tools.description: Stops idle simulators, emulators and daemons, biggest first, until about this much RAM is freed.

tools.name: find_free_port
tools.description: The first TCP port from start that nothing listens on.
